title: Truncation without ROUNDED and ROUNDED ported as HALF_EVEN
business_cause: Calculated fees differ by one cent due to different rounding rules.
probable_cause: Faulty Java uses HALF_EVEN where COBOL has ROUNDED (default HALF_UP).
technical_cause: Faulty Java uses HALF_EVEN where COBOL has ROUNDED (default HALF_UP).
business_fix: Apply the same rounding rule the COBOL program uses: round away from zero, not to the nearest even number.
fix_sentence: Use RoundingMode.HALF_UP for ROUNDED and RoundingMode.DOWN for truncation.
